title: HSK2 Gate 14 · Northern Song
explanationEn: Gate 14: Northern Song. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第14关：北宋。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 中国人做出了很多有用的东西。其中最有名的有四个。第一个是纸。因为有了纸，人们才可以写书。
passageEn: Chinese people made many useful things. Four of them are the most famous. The first is paper. It was paper that made books possible.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: Chinese people made many useful things.
comprehension.answer: 中国人做出了很多有用的东西。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 人 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“人”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 人 (rén) means "person" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “人”（rén）的意思是“person”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 做 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“做”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 做 (zuò) means "do" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “做”（zuò）的意思是“do”，就在上面的短文里。

check.zh: 中国人做出了很多有用的东西。

options.text: Chinese people made many useful things.
Very long ago, it rained in China for many days.
Because there was so much rain, the water rose higher and higher.
The water came into the fields, and into many people’s homes.

check.explanationEn: "中国人做出了很多有用的东西。" means "Chinese people made many useful things.".
check.explanation: “中国人做出了很多有用的东西。”的意思是“Chinese people made many useful things.”。

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Northern Song in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说北宋。
